citations.quote: first articulation of successive notional portfolios, each isolating one step in the investment decision process.
importantly, the order of the decision process, we can still employ the Brinson model.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Multi-level attribution as a chain of successive notional funds (policy -> strategy -> selection), each isolating one decision step; Holbrook's three-level pension framework links the chain to Fama-style risk decomposition.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Multi-Level Attribution and Successive Notional Funds
